answer: The record is checked live against the issuing authority each epoch, and a revoked or missing entry loses the seat. A farm faking 243 aliases needs 243 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Gaming achievement streak with platform attestation is the check: achievements earned steadily over years. Watch the lotus: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the mesa bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the glacier audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
